description: This file defines an abstract base class 'BaseTextFilter' for text filter components within the Pipecat framework. It specifies the interface and some default behaviors for filters that modify text in a processing pipeline, including methods for updating settings, filtering text, and handling interruptions.

classes.name: BaseTextFilter
classes.description: Abstract base class for text filters in the Pipecat framework, providing interface methods for filtering text, updating settings, and handling interruptions.

methods.name: update_settings(self, settings: Mapping[str, Any])
methods.description: Asynchronously updates the filter's configuration settings. Intended to be overridden by subclasses to handle runtime configuration changes.

methods.name: str filter(self, text: str)
methods.description: Abstract method that subclasses must implement to apply specific text filtering transformations asynchronously.

methods.name: handle_interruption(self)
methods.description: Asynchronously handles cleanup or state reset when an interruption occurs in the processing pipeline.

methods.name: reset_interruption(self)
methods.description: Asynchronously resets the filter's state after an interruption has been handled.

ctags.name: filter
ctags.pattern: /^    async def filter(self, text: str) -> str:$/

ctags.name: update_settings
ctags.pattern: /^    async def update_settings(self, settings: Mapping[str, Any]):$/
